summary: John's 5th-great-grand-aunt; wife of Col. George P. Ransom.
bio: Elizabeth Lamoreaux (30 Sep 1776 - 27 Aug 1859) married Col. George Palmer Ransom in 1794; 13 children. Her children, incl. Chester Ransom (1808-1893), are John's 1st cousins 7x removed.
sources: WikiTree Lamoreaux-21 (Thomas Lamoreaux; full will transcription citing FamilySearch images of Luzerne Will Book A): https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Lamoreaux-21 ; PAGenWeb will transcription: http://www.pagenweb.org/~luzerne/patk/tomlam.htm
